stem.en: Which list gives the ages in the right order, from oldest to newest?

text.en: Palaeolithic, Neolithic, Mesolithic, Chalcolithic, Bronze Age, Iron Age

feedback.en: Meso means middle, so the Mesolithic comes between the Old and the New Stone Age.

text.en: Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic, Bronze Age, Chalcolithic, Iron Age

feedback.en: Bronze is made by mixing copper with tin, and copper was in use first, so the Chalcolithic comes before the Bronze Age.

text.en: Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic, Chalcolithic, Bronze Age, Iron Age
Palaeolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic, Chalcolithic, Iron Age, Bronze Age

feedback.en: The Iron Age is the last of the six, after the Bronze Age.

explanation.en: The three stages of the Stone Age come first: old, middle, new. Copper then comes in alongside stone in the Chalcolithic, bronze follows, and iron comes last.

hints.en: Palaeo means old, meso means middle, neo means new.
